sourceRef.section: APPENDIX E — GRAND FACTION POLITICAL TASKS — Campaign Mode — Revised for Current Campaign Rules

overview.summary: This appendix contains thirty faction-specific political Task cards. Each of the five Grand Factions contributes: two Open Tasks, two Sponsored Tasks, two Exclusive Tasks.
rules: These Tasks follow the standard requirements established in Appendix D.
A faction-specific Task enters the eligible catalog only when its associated Grand Faction participates in the campaign.
When drawing or displaying an invalid Task, substitute another legal Task of the same Open, Sponsored, or Exclusive category, as described in Appendix D.
The associated faction's narrative identity does not bypass the normal target, sponsor, or beneficiary requirements.

factionTaskRules.open: Any eligible participating Grand Faction may claim the Task, provided it has a legitimate connection to the chosen target.
factionTaskRules.sponsored: The Task requires the backing of the specified institution, community, or political sponsor. The Task's associated Grand Faction does not automatically satisfy the sponsoring requirement merely because its name appears on the card.
factionTaskRules.exclusive: The associated Grand Faction is the designated beneficiary unless a successful mission establishes another explicitly permitted outcome. A rival may obstruct an Exclusive Task, potentially causing it to resolve as Neutral.
pcAffiliatedFaction: When the associated Grand Faction is the PCs' own political sponsor, the PCs may complete its Exclusive Tasks on that power's behalf.
Because the PC-affiliated Grand Faction does not play a separate NPC Maneuver, the PCs must obtain the result through an eligible Company mission or another expressly permitted action.
factionTaskRules.mapTargetNote: All faction Tasks use flexible map targets. Named Capital landmarks are thematic references, not required physical locations. Specify any actual military recruitment right or equipment/Asset access obtained through a material consequence; a generic statement about recognition never unlocks an entire foreign roster or waives ordinary Points, Gold, or recruitment slots.

factions.description: The Unbound favor independent communities, exploration, mutual assistance, and protection against centralized control. Their Tasks often reward diplomatic legitimacy and access to frontier support rather than large permanent military institutions.

tasks.name: Assembly of Freeholders
tasks.eligibleTarget: An independent settlement, frontier council, or gathering of regional representatives.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain public recognition for a cooperative arrangement among free communities.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Maintain a genuine relationship with at least one represented community.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may establish a Political Influence contact, passage rights, or another specified local political concession. The assembly does not automatically transfer settlement ownership.

tasks.name: Paths of the Untamed
tasks.eligibleTarget: A wilderness route, unresolved Site, old frontier trail, or remote passage.
tasks.stakeObjective: Earn recognition for identifying, recovering, or securing useful knowledge of a frontier route.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Possess legal exploratory access to the selected region.
tasks.materialConsequence: A successful expedition may reveal safe passage, a hidden Site, or a previously unknown resource connection. Constructing a permanent Road still requires an eligible construction project.

tasks.name: Defense of the Homesteads
tasks.eligibleTarget: An independent settlement facing a credible military or monstrous threat.
tasks.requiredSponsor: The threatened settlement or its recognized representatives.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition as an appropriate protector of the community.
tasks.materialConsequence: Completing the required defense or agreement may provide a local militia commitment or continuing protective treaty. The local defenders do not automatically become permanent company property.

tasks.name: The Common Harvest
tasks.eligibleTarget: A frontier cooperative, productive settlement, or Supply-bearing community.
tasks.requiredSponsor: A recognized local producer or community association.
tasks.stakeObjective: Support a cooperative provisioning arrangement without forcing direct annexation.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed contract may provide temporary Supply access or authorization for an appropriate logistical Improvement. A successful Industry trick does not create an additional printed resource symbol.

tasks.name: Charter of the Free Peoples
tasks.eligibleTarget: A settlement seeking recognition of independent government or a free-company charter.
tasks.stakeObjective: Secure recognition of the Unbound's proposed charter and its protection of local autonomy. Rival factions may challenge or obstruct the proposed settlement.
tasks.materialConsequence: A legitimate agreement may establish recognized free-company recruitment rights, a defensive obligation, or political cooperation. The settlement remains independent unless a separate agreement explicitly changes its sovereignty.

tasks.name: Guardians of the Greenward
tasks.eligibleTarget: A wilderness Site, protected frontier territory, or community possessing important local knowledge.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish the Unbound's recognized responsibility for protecting or investigating the location.
tasks.materialConsequence: Rescuing local scouts, completing a Site, or negotiating an agreement may unlock one specified frontier specialist formation or reconnaissance Asset. No unit is granted solely for winning the Stake.

factions.description: The Conclave prioritizes research, industry, institutional authority, and specialist military development. Its Tasks provide opportunities for scientific discoveries, production agreements, and access to unusual military equipment.

tasks.name: The Arcane Survey
tasks.eligibleTarget: A magical anomaly, abandoned research location, unusual natural feature, or unresolved Site.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition for investigating the phenomenon or establishing its scholarly significance.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Possess credible investigative access or sponsorship from an appropriate research institution.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed study may reveal an equipment improvement, specialist research opportunity, or unusual Site information. Research recognition does not automatically create a completed military Asset.

tasks.name: The Artificers' Exchange
tasks.eligibleTarget: A guild, Workshop, equipment market, or comparable production institution.
tasks.stakeObjective: Secure recognition for a cooperative technical or industrial exchange.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Possess a legal connection to the participating producers.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed arrangement may unlock crafting access, specialist repair services, or one specified military equipment option. Purchases and Develop projects retain their ordinary costs unless an explicit reward changes them.

tasks.name: The Academy Commission
tasks.eligibleTarget: A laboratory, local industrial partner, recognized guild, or military equipment institution.
tasks.requiredSponsor: A recognized academic, civic, or guild institution supporting the commission.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition as the appropriate executor or sponsor of a specialized research or manufacturing project.
tasks.materialConsequence: A fulfilled commission may provide access to one specified Elite Support formation, Artillery formation, or exceptional equipment category. The commission must identify the actual military option granted. It does not unlock the Conclave's entire roster.

tasks.name: The Keeping of the Seals
tasks.eligibleTarget: A dangerous archive, forbidden Site, research repository, or contained magical threat.
tasks.requiredSponsor: The recognized custodian or institution responsible for the location.
tasks.stakeObjective: Earn recognition for safeguarding the institution or investigating its dangers.
tasks.materialConsequence: Successful containment may deny an adversary access to a named dangerous Asset, protect an existing facility, or grant specific research information. Such restrictions require the actual containment objective to be completed. A Discovery trick alone cannot seal a hostile facility permanently.

tasks.name: Patent of the Archmagisters
tasks.eligibleTarget: A research institution, valuable invention, or disputed specialist production right.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition of the Conclave's proposed custodianship or exclusive production patent.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may restrict a named specialist equipment source to approved partners. Existing permanently owned units are not automatically erased. An invalidated contract affects future recruitment and support according to its terms.

tasks.name: The Luminarium Prototype
tasks.eligibleTarget: A research facility, Workshop, experimental equipment project, or recoverable prototype.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish the Conclave as the recognized sponsor or custodian of a significant experimental project.
tasks.materialConsequence: Completing the project may provide one named specialist Asset, exceptional equipment item, or experimental formation. Its final acquisition must be supported by the actual project outcome and any required facility. Winning the Industry trick does not automatically place a completed prototype into the army.

factions.description: The Wayfarers prioritize clan relationships, ancestral responsibilities, secure travel, and mutual defense. Their Tasks emphasize traditional obligations and the military support available from regional alliances.

tasks.name: Paths of the Pilgrims
tasks.eligibleTarget: An ancestral route, frontier Site, mountain passage, or culturally important landmark.
tasks.stakeObjective: Earn recognition for restoring or maintaining access to an important regional journey.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Possess a genuine connection to the route, travelers, or associated institution.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed expedition may reveal an accessible path, hidden Site, or useful local guides. Permanent Roads and Bridges require their normal construction procedures.

tasks.name: The Roadward Patrol
tasks.eligibleTarget: A trade route, caravan path, settlement approach, or threatened regional passage.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition for defending travelers and maintaining security on the selected route.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Maintain an eligible military presence or a recognized protection agreement.
tasks.materialConsequence: An actual successful patrol, escort, or defensive mission may restore safe passage or create a specified military protection obligation. A Warfare trick does not automatically defeat raiders or establish political control.

tasks.name: The Council of Clans
tasks.eligibleTarget: A gathering of clan representatives, an oathbound settlement, or an established regional assembly.
tasks.requiredSponsor: At least one recognized clan or community representative independent of the claimant.
tasks.stakeObjective: Secure recognition of a proposed arrangement among the participating clans.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may grant a political contact, passage right, or temporary allied warband. The warband's duration, ownership, and recruitment requirements must be stated in the agreement.

tasks.name: The Oathbound Caravan
tasks.eligibleTarget: A protected caravan, regional trade expedition, or isolated supply community.
tasks.requiredSponsor: The caravan owner, merchant association, or community arranging the journey.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish the claimant as a recognized escort, trading partner, or supplier.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed escort or contract may establish Supply access, commercial rights, or an appropriate military transport arrangement. The convoy does not automatically provide free formations or permanent resource ownership.

tasks.name: Succession at the Oathstone
tasks.eligibleTarget: A disputed clan leadership position, ancestral oath, or recognized regional succession.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition for the Wayfarers' proposed leadership settlement.
tasks.materialConsequence: A successfully resolved dispute may establish access to one named commander, allied clan formation, or political agreement. The arrangement does not provide additional Command Points or unrestricted military recruitment. The PCs may support or contest the succession through the narrative mission.

tasks.name: Banner of the Wandering Host
tasks.eligibleTarget: An oathbound warband, ancestral standard, military rallying point, or threatened allied settlement.
tasks.stakeObjective: Recognize the Wayfarers' authority to assemble a regional defensive host.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed muster or military agreement may unlock one specified allied warband, cavalry contingent, or other appropriate formation. The unit must be acquired according to its agreement and deployed legally. Winning the Warfare trick does not automatically assemble a free army.

factions.description: The Legions prioritize organized military power, strategic infrastructure, territorial security, and recognized command authority. Their Tasks support professional army development and the political mechanisms sustaining large military operations.

tasks.name: The Military Road
tasks.eligibleTarget: A suitable military passage, supply route, or strategically important connection between regions.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition for securing or developing an important military transport corridor.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Maintain a plausible military or logistical connection to the selected route.
tasks.materialConsequence: A legal construction operation may establish a Road, Bridge, or appropriate supply Improvement. Recognition does not construct the infrastructure without the relevant project.

tasks.name: Frontier Interception
tasks.eligibleTarget: A hostile patrol, raiding force, disputed border approach, or threatened settlement.
tasks.stakeObjective: Earn recognition for responding to a credible military threat.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Maintain an eligible Force, defensive obligation, or appropriate mission access.
tasks.materialConsequence: A successful interception may preserve a settlement, secure a route, or remove the identified threat. The enemy is not destroyed merely because the claimant wins a Warfare card contest.

tasks.name: The Provincial Garrison
tasks.eligibleTarget: A settlement requesting protection, military administration, or garrison support.
tasks.requiredSponsor: The relevant Local Authority or settlement government.
tasks.stakeObjective: Obtain recognition for an authorized garrison arrangement.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may provide a regional recruitment charter, authorized garrison position, or temporary local militia contingent. The sponsoring settlement retains political control unless the agreement explicitly transfers it.

tasks.name: The Quartermaster's Route
tasks.eligibleTarget: An important supply junction, military storehouse, caravan source, or logistical route.
tasks.requiredSponsor: A relevant quartermaster institution, military organization, or commercial supplier.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition for maintaining the sponsor's supply arrangements.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed operation may establish a legal Supply connection, access to repairs, or an approved military supply agreement. It does not generate automatic Gold or unrestricted replacement formations.

tasks.name: Appointment of the Marshal
tasks.eligibleTarget: A disputed military command, army headquarters, or recognized appointment of a senior officer.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition of the Legions' proposed military appointment.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed appointment may make one named commander or eligible signature formation available through the ordinary roster and military access rules. It does not grant additional Doctrine commands or Command Points. The appointed officer must still be legally included in an army.

tasks.name: The Iron Offensive
tasks.eligibleTarget: A strategically important military position reachable by a Legion Force or an established allied army.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition for the Legions' declared military campaign or regional security objective. The PCs may undermine the operation through reconnaissance, diplomacy, or a suitable battle.
tasks.materialConsequence: A successful military operation may capture an eligible position, deny an opponent access to a military facility, or complete another stated military objective. Winning the Warfare trick alone does not constitute a conquest.
tasks.actINote: During Act I, the Stake may concern preparation and public recognition of the planned offensive; actual territorial conquest must await a legal military operation.

factions.description: Concord prioritizes institutional cooperation, diplomatic recognition, mutually beneficial commerce, and military alliances. Its Tasks provide ways to build coalition support without requiring direct territorial annexation.

tasks.name: The Shared Market
tasks.eligibleTarget: A regional market, merchant coalition, trade junction, or recognized economic institution.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition for organizing or supporting a cooperative trading arrangement.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Maintain a legitimate commercial relationship with at least one participating institution.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may provide trade access, a mercenary hiring contact, or authorization for a suitable commercial Improvement. The Stake does not automatically generate passive Gold income.

tasks.name: Civic Mediation
tasks.eligibleTarget: A dispute between settlements, guilds, Grand Factions, or other recognized political authorities.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition as an appropriate mediator of the dispute.
tasks.claimantRequirement: Possess a legitimate diplomatic connection or invitation to the negotiation.
tasks.materialConsequence: A successful settlement may establish a treaty, Political Influence contact, concession, or recognized resolution of a local grievance. Mediation does not automatically force either party to surrender territory or military assets.

tasks.name: The Union Charter
tasks.eligibleTarget: Two or more communities, civic institutions, or recognized political organizations considering formal cooperation.
tasks.requiredSponsor: At least one participating institution authorizing negotiation of the proposed Charter.
tasks.stakeObjective: Earn recognition for organizing the proposed union or institutional agreement.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed Charter may establish commercial access, defensive obligations, political cooperation, or a specified recruitment right. The participating institutions retain their existing sovereignty unless the agreement explicitly provides otherwise.

tasks.name: The Mutual Defense Accord
tasks.eligibleTarget: A settlement, important route, allied institution, or region facing a credible military threat.
tasks.requiredSponsor: A community or political authority seeking a formal defensive arrangement.
tasks.stakeObjective: Gain recognition as a legitimate defensive partner.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed agreement may provide one temporary allied contingent or specified defensive recruitment right. Actual deployment depends on the agreement, available formations, and normal point and slot restrictions. The Accord does not create a free formation merely from its political marker.

tasks.name: The Hall of Delegates
tasks.eligibleTarget: An assembly of political representatives, disputed diplomatic institution, or regional council.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition of Concord's proposed role as convenor or coordinating authority.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed diplomatic arrangement may provide an authorized Political Influence contact, a qualified Political Mandate for the company, or one specified institutional privilege. A Political Mandate requires the relevant independent power to agree; recognition of the council does not automatically compel an unrelated faction to obey.

tasks.name: Accord of the Five Roads
tasks.eligibleTarget: A network of important routes, trade connections, and frontier approaches.
tasks.stakeObjective: Establish recognition of Concord's proposed regional travel and access agreement.
tasks.titleNote: The title refers to the Compact's traditional ideal of connecting distant communities. It does not require five literal Roads to exist on the current board.
tasks.materialConsequence: A completed survey or treaty may establish specified passage rights, identify missing regional connections, or secure legal access to a trade route. The agreement does not construct free Roads or automatically connect disconnected supply networks.
